7. INSTALL THINNER SNAP RING IN CLUTCH DRUM
(a) Remove the outer snap ring, rear clutch hub and disc to allow installation of the thinner snap ring.
(b) Compress and lower the snap ring into the groove by hand. Check that the ends of the snap ring are not aligned with one of the cutouts.

8. INSTALL DISC

9. INSTALL INNER THRUST BEARING AND RACES
IMPORTANT: Coat parts with petroleum jelly to hold them in place.
Install the inner race, needle bearing and outer race. Press them into place.
NOTE: Face the lip of race toward the front of the clutch body.

10. INSTALL FRONT CLUTCH HUB
Align the disc lugs with the hub teeth. Make sure the hub meshes with all discs and is fully inserted.

11. INSTALL REAR CLUTCH HUB AND OUTER SNAP RING
Check that the snap ring ends are not aligned with one of the cutouts.
NOTE: Note the position of the inner thrust bearing and races, and keep them together until assembly.

12. KEEP THRUST BEARINGS AND RACES TOGETHER
